text:
alex: FYI prod warmup failures in eu-west after the midnight firewall hardening. Seeing `kms:AccessDenied` and `connect:timeout` from the keystore path.
tanya: Which rule? the deny-by-default we shipped at 00:05?
alex: yes. firewall logs: `dst=10.34.2.9:443 action=deny proto=tcp tag=gpu-warmup`
marc: Oof. Nodes can't reach keystore-proxy health endpoint, they retry and get stuck in provisioning. Metric: gpu.node.provision_fail_rate spiked to 22% for 15m.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-3301 (warmup failures eu-west)
tanya: Immediate rollback is heavy. Can we add a scoped exception for `gpu-warmup` tags to keystore-proxy CIDR and only for ephemeral ports 32768-32780?
alex: Yes. Proposal: allow tcp 32768-32780 from tag:gpu-warmup -> keystore-proxy:443 for 30m then monitor.
marc: Also seeing a KMS alias mismatch: some nodes call `alias/keystore-legacy` which is scheduled to be retired next week as part of the HSM migration. If we rotate keys while connectivity is blocked we could orphan nodes.
tanya: Can we defer the alias rotation until warmup stabilizes? Security would prefer rotation on schedule but prod reliability is higher priority.
finance: Any cost impact to temporary allow? NAT egress stays same; main cost is cross-AZ if proxy sits in different AZ. Estimate ~15GB/hr => ~$1.2/hr. Approve for short window.
alex: I'll roll the firewall exception now and add a dev note. Patch: `fw rule add allow tag:gpu-warmup dest:10.34.2.0/24 proto:tcp dport:443 sport:32768-32780 comment:"keystore warmup exception"`
marc: While we're at it, can keystore-proxy append `legacy_shard=alias/keystore-legacy` and `proxy_node` to the audit payload so auditors can trace fallback traffic?
audit-bot: Audit schema requires `actor`, `action`, `resource_id`, optional `metadata`. Adding fields is allowed with review.
tanya: We'll do minimal enrichment: add `metadata.legacy_shard` and `metadata.proxy_node`. Make sure this doesn't include secrets.
alex: envoy snippet for header injection: ```- name: add-metadata
  headers_to_add:
    - header:
        key: x-audit-metadata
        value: "legacy_shard=alias/keystore-legacy;proxy_node=%HOSTNAME%"```
marc: Good. Also add a CloudWatch alarm for `keystore.fallback_count` so we can see if legacy hits persist.
sre-bot: Rolling change window opened by alex: firewall-exception (id=fw-331)

alex: Deployed the fw exception, canaries show keystore connect success on 5 nodes in eu-west. Provisioning resumed.
marc: Confirmed: warmup success rate normalized. Defer rotation.
tanya: Action items: 
- rollback alias rotation scheduled tomorrow -> moved 
- add audit metadata in keystore-proxy (PR up) 
- monitor fallback_count metric for 48h 
- finance approved short-elev cost

alex: PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/1420 (proxy audit fields + fw change docs)
audit-bot: Noted: change will be logged in audit trail. Please ensure PR references ticket INC-3301.
marc: If fallback_count stays >0 after 48h we plan a small migration run where we update node bootstrap logic to prefer `alias/keystore-shard-new` and emit telemetry. That reduces reliance on proxy-rewrite.
finance: Keep cost tracker updated in the PR. Approve spend up to $200 for emergency egress.

alex: tagging owners: @tanya (firewall), @marc (warmup), @alex (keystore changes). Scheduling retrospective after incident closed. :white_check_mark:
